svg.title: Syncope decision chart: confirm a transient loss of consciousness, then the history's red flags split benign reflex (vasovagal) syncope from cardiac syncope, which is obstructive, bradycardic or tachycardic; each column gives the clues, the investigations in order and the treatment

svg.text: syncope = transient loss of consciousness from low brain blood flow, recovering on its own

svg.text: first CONFIRM it: not a trip, weakness or dizziness

svg.text: the HISTORY sorts it: circumstances, prodrome, recovery, witnesses, heart disease, family history of sudden death
